newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong gold ends barely lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends barely lower in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended barely lower on Thursday from New York's previous close in very light trade and slight selling from Tokyo, dealers said on Thursday.
Hong Kong gold closed at US$325.70/326.20 per ounce, barely lower than New York's Wednesday close at US$325.80/30 per ounce.
Spot gold traded in a tight, one-dollar range, with support seen at $325 per ounce and resistence at $328 per ounce.
Light selling pressure from Japan was met by buying interest at $325.50 per ounce.
Physical demand was slow, traders said.
Local tael gold closed at HK$3,018 per tael, unchanged from its previous close.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -4.00 from the previous fix at nil.
